_comment: Lychee's pack catalogue. Lychee has no network access: 'download' (a direct link to a file on the public 'packs' release of lychee-keyboard/lychee, where the packs workflow builds or mirrors every pack) opens in the browser, which saves the file; opening it installs it in Lychee. 'url' is the pack's source, for credit and updates. 'sha256' (optional) pins an exact file; 'pick' chooses the font inside a zip; 'prefer' breaks ties between matches. 'emoji' is the Emoji version a font covers; 'preview' is a picture of the font, shown before it is downloaded (data/packs/fonts/render_preview.js).
